_comment: Spec for the editor's Azure Front Door rule set. Applied by wasm/apply-front-door-rules.sh (delete-and-recreate, idempotent by sha256 of the applier script). This JSON is informational + the source of truth for what's intended; the applier script is what runs in CI.
_designNote: The editor storage account is single-purpose: per-deploy builds at /<APP_BUILD_ID>/<path>. Every byte is content-addressed by URL — the <id>/ folder IS the version. So everything is immutable. Updates ship as a new <id>/ folder + a viewer-side pointer flip; existing in-flight tabs keep working at the previous id until reload.
_brotliNote: Brotli is NOT done via FD URL rewrite (AFD's UrlRewrite action doesn't support server-variable interpolation in destinations, so a per-deploy-templated brotli swap isn't expressible). Instead the deploy step (wasm/deploy-front-door.sh) uploads each pre-built `.br` sidecar's bytes as the canonical blob URL with Content-Encoding: br metadata. Browsers receive brotli bytes + the encoding header and decompress transparently. All modern browsers support brotli; non-brotli clients (legacy tooling) get undecodable bytes — theoretical concern for the editor's audience.

rules.name: globalHeaders
rules._purpose: COOP/COEP/CORP enable SharedArrayBuffer (required by WASM threads). CORS lets the viewer iframe embed cool.html cross-origin. These apply to every response, including 404s.

rules.name: immutableAll
rules._purpose: Every URL on this storage is per-deploy-versioned by its <id>/ path. Cache forever. Updates create a new <id>/ folder; the viewer's pointer flip steers traffic.
